Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis

Sixu Yan    Shikang Wang    Binhua Huang    Xuanlai Tang    Guohua Fan    Fan Huang    Haoxuan Li    Yongkang Li    Yuhan Li    Bencheng Liao    Zeyu Zhang    Wenyu Liu    Hangxin Liu    Xinggang Wang ††thanks: Sixu Yan and Shikang Wang contributed equally to this work. Abstract

This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive vlg (vlg) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing vlg methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/.

Index Terms: 
Adaptive vision-language grasping, Generalizable grasp synthesis, Foundation models for embodied AI

I Introduction

Grasping is one of the most fundamental skills required by robots for physical interaction [1]. Despite substantial progress, the grasp generation problem remains challenging due to the difficulty in robustly selecting a grasp among almost infinite possible configurations between an end-effector and an object. More importantly, a grasp is inherently contextual. The same object may require entirely different grasp strategies depending on its surroundings, task objectives, and interaction dynamics. As illustrated in Fig. 1a, executing the task instruction “Grasp the mug to ⟨\langleaction⟩\rangle” oftentimes involves such intertwined factors. The target object may be partially occluded or covered by clutter, restricting feasible approach directions and grasp configurations. The grasp itself must satisfy functional requirements associated with subsequent object use: pour water or hand it over. And continuous adjustment is required for a successful grasp when the object or robot is moving. These spatial, cognitive, and temporal challenges frequently arise simultaneously, making robust and adaptive grasping particularly difficult.

Humans, in contrast, can effortlessly adapt their grasping behaviors to such combined challenges in varying situations. A key reason is that humans exploit rich priors accumulated from commonsense knowledge [2] and past experience [3] to guide perception [4], reasoning, and motor coordination [5]. Such priors enable efficient selection and adaptation of grasp strategies without requiring exhaustive experience for every possible situation.

Analogous to the role of prior knowledge in human intelligence, foundation models have shown strong capabilities to provide informative priors for visual recognition and tracking [6, 7], spatial understanding [8, 9], embodied reasoning [10, 11], and robot control [12, 13]. In particular, their powerful visual recognition and language understanding capabilities have fueled the emergence of vlg models [14, 15, 16, 17, 18], which exhibit strong generalization capabilities and support natural interactions by tightly integrating perception and grasp execution. However, existing vlg methods predominantly incorporate foundation models within an end-to-end framework that directly maps visual observations and language instructions to grasp poses (see Fig. 1b). Although effective, the performance of such specialized policies is largely constrained by the coverage of training data, model scale, and computational resources [14, 16, 18]. As a result, scaling these policies to cover the vast diversity of grasp configurations, task intents, and environmental dynamics encountered in the real world remains impractical [19].

Taking a different perspective, we propose AdaRoboVLG, an adaptive vision-language grasping framework (see Fig. 1c) that decouples task-dependent understanding from physical grasp synthesis. Specifically, we design a structured grasp interface consisting of object geometry, cgr [20], and grasp types. A cgr encodes a local contact primitive on the object surface, including the contact location, approach direction, closing direction, and grasp width. The grasp types follow the human grasp taxonomy [21] and are kinematically compatible with the target robotic hand. Centered on this structured grasp interface, we first learn an efficient base policy that converts the interface into hand-specific grasp candidates and selects the most stable candidate using a learned decision model that evaluates force-closure conditions [22]. Throughout this process, complementary foundation-model priors for spatial understanding, cognitive reasoning, and temporal tracking construct or update the structured grasp interface, allowing the base policy to synthesize grasps that are both task-consistent and physically executable.

Fig. 2 illustrates three representative examples. (i) By lifting DINOv3 [7] features extracted from multi-view RGB-D observations into 3D space, the spatial prior predicts global cgr, providing spatially feasible contact constraints for grasp synthesis in cluttered scenes. (ii) By combining an llm (llm) augmented with rag (rag) [23] over a grasp-examples database with structured cot (cot) [24] reasoning, and SAM3 [25]-based visual grounding, the cognitive prior localizes the target object, refines the cgr, and infers appropriate grasp types for functional grasp generation according to language instructions. (iii) By combining the mask-tracking capability of SAM3 with the cross-frame feature consistency of DINOv3, the temporal prior estimates the motion of target geometry and cgr online, enabling grasps to be continuously updated for dynamic objects. More importantly, these spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors modify the same structured grasp interface, allowing them to operate independently or jointly while enabling contextually adaptive grasp generation across a wide range of scenarios.

In simulation experiments, we first validate that the base policy is effective and generalizable, which not only exhibits efficient learning but also facilitates cross-hand deployment. Building on this base policy, we further evaluate the contextual adaptation of AdaRoboVLG enabled by three types of example foundation priors. For clutter-aware grasping, the spatial prior enables AdaRoboVLG to achieve an average success rate of 88.4% across three robotic hands and three clutter levels on the DexGraspNet 2.0 [26]基准，在随机和松散的分割上取得了最先进的结果。对于功能性抓取，我们通过两个互补的实验来评估认知先验。在抓取功能推理中，它在开放集基准上实现了 94.0% 和 87.0% 的功能部分和抓取类型准确度。在语言引导的目标抓取中，AdaRoboVLG 在基于 GraspClutter6D 构建的模拟基准上实现了 81.3% 和 86.0% 的最佳平均成功率benchmark, achieving state-of-the-art results on the random and loose splits. For functional grasping, we evaluate the cognitive prior through two complementary experiments. In grasp functionality inference, it achieves functional-part and grasp-type accuracies of 94.0% and 87.0% on an open-set benchmark. In language-guided target grasping, AdaRoboVLG achieves the best average success rates of 81.3% and 86.0% on simulation benchmarks built from GraspClutter6D[27]和 GraspNet-10 亿and GraspNet-1Billion[28]，分别。最后，对于动态抓取，对 GraspNet-1Billion 的评估表明，与现有抓取跟踪方法相比，时间先验能够实现完美的跟踪关联精度、最低的平移误差和竞争性旋转误差。, respectively. Finally, for dynamic grasping, evaluations on GraspNet-1Billion show that the temporal prior enables perfect tracking association accuracy, the lowest translation errors, and competitive rotation errors compared to existing grasp-tracking methods.

在现实世界中，我们进一步验证了空间、认知和时间先验可以联合整合以解决更具挑战性的抓取任务。对于杂乱场景中的功能性抓取，AdaRoboVLG 在 6 个类别的 102 个日常物体的 510 次试验中取得了 83.3% 的总体成功率。在移动的传送带上，AdaRoboVLG 能够在动态杂乱的场景中进行功能性抓取，同时以 5 Hz 的频率执行在线抓取更新。我们还评估了 AdaRoboVLG 在四种人为干扰下的跟踪鲁棒性，其平均成功率为 89.7%。In real-world settings, we further validate that the spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors can be jointly integrated to address more challenging grasping tasks. For functional grasping in cluttered scenes, AdaRoboVLG achieves an overall success rate of 83.3% over 510 trials across 102 everyday objects from six categories. On a moving conveyor belt, AdaRoboVLG enables functional grasping in dynamic cluttered scenes, while performing online grasp updates at 5 Hz. We also evaluate the tracking robustness of AdaRoboVLG under four types of human-induced disturbances, where it achieves an average success rate of 89.7%.

这项工作的更广泛的影响超出了掌握绩效本身。将物理掌握合成与任务相关理解解耦不仅可以提高数据和训练效率，还可以建立一个稳定的接口，通过该接口可以随着时间的推移集成功能日益增强的基础模型。未来感知和推理的进步可以通过仅更新相应的基础先验模块来直接转化为改进的掌握能力，而不是重复地重新训练端到端策略。The broader implications of this work extend beyond grasping performance itself. Decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding not only improves data and training efficiency, but also establishes a stable interface through which increasingly capable foundation models can be integrated over time. Rather than repeatedly retraining end-to-end policies, future advances in perception and reasoning can be directly translated into improved grasping capabilities by updating only the corresponding foundation-prior modules.

II 相关工作Related Work

Ⅱ-AII-A 视觉语言条件机器人抓取Vision-Language-Conditioned Robotic Grasping

视觉语言抓取使机器人能够根据人类指令进行精确的抓取。为了解决图中所示的挑战Vision-language grasping enables robots to perform precise grasps based on human instructions. To address the challenges illustrated inFig. 1a，最近的作品通过利用, recent works have advanced this direction by leveraging勒姆llm和and弗洛姆vlm(i) 为掌握策略提供与任务相关的指导，例如语义线索to (i) provide task-relevant guidance for grasp policies, such as semantic cues[29, 30], 对象可供性, object affordances[31, 32]和空间先验, and spatial priors[33, 34]; (ii) 执行高级别任务规划; (ii) perform high-level task planning[35, 36]和函数推理and functional reasoning[37, 38]; (iii) 开发端到端; and (iii) develop end-to-end弗拉vla (弗拉vla) 型号) models[14, 16, 15, 18]，在大规模机器人数据集上进行训练，直接生成可行的抓取姿势, trained on large-scale robotic datasets, to directly generate feasible grasp poses[16, 18]或连续动作or continuous actions[14, 15].

然而，这些方法通常是特定于任务和手工的，在适应新任务或实施例时需要额外的数据收集和策略培训。 AdaRoboVLG 通过不同的基础先验将任务理解与掌握综合解耦，从而解决了这一限制。可以通过更新相关先验来适应新的任务要求，而通过重用共享掌握策略来支持新的实施例，而无需修改整个框架。However, these methods are often task- and hand-specific, requiring additional data collection and policy training when adapting to new tasks or embodiments. AdaRoboVLG addresses this limitation by decoupling task understanding from grasp synthesis through diverse foundation priors. New task requirements can be accommodated by updating the relevant priors, while new embodiments are supported by reusing the shared grasp policy, without modifying the entire framework.

Ⅱ-BII-B 基于学习的多指抓取姿势合成Learning-Based Multi-Finger Grasp Pose Synthesis

基于学习的多指抓取合成可以大致分为四种有代表性的范例。具体来说，以手为中心的方法直接映射感知观察以掌握动作Learning-based multi-finger grasp synthesis can be broadly categorized into four representative paradigms. Specifically, hand-centric methods directly map perceptual observations to grasp actions[39, 40, 41, 42, 43]，实现高效推理，但仍受限于特定的手部实施例。以对象为中心的方法使用接触图改进交叉手泛化, enabling efficient inference but remaining constrained to specific hand embodiments. Object-centric methods improve cross-hand generalization using contact maps[44, 45]或联络点or contact points[46, 47]，但通常需要昂贵的非凸优化, but often require costly nonconvex optimization[48]。以交互为中心的方法通过显式建模手-对象关系进一步平衡泛化和效率. Interaction-centric methods further balance generalization and efficiency by explicitly modeling hand-object relationships[49, 50, 51]。然而，这些范例主要关注对象级掌握综合。最近，以场景为中心的方法已将抓取合成扩展到杂乱的环境中. However, these paradigms primarily focus on object-level grasp synthesis. More recently, scene-centric methods have extended grasp synthesis to cluttered environments[52, 26, 53]，但它们的抓取生成和决策过程通常与特定的手部实施例相结合。, but their grasp generation and decision processes are typically coupled with specific hand embodiments.

借鉴这些成果，AdaRoboVLG 将抓取合成分解为两个阶段，每个阶段都建立在与手无关的表示之上。在抓取生成过程中，Drawing from these efforts, AdaRoboVLG decomposes grasp synthesis into two stages, with each stage built upon a hand-agnostic representation. During grasp generation,累积量cgr，编码基本接触基元，通过显式映射函数转换为可执行的手部特定抓取候选对象。在掌握决策期间，这些候选者使用建议的编码, which encode fundamental contact primitives, are converted into executable hand-specific grasp candidates through an explicit mapping function. During grasp decision, these candidates are encoded using the proposed海hoi表示并通过与手无关的决策模型进行评估。这种设计保留了高效的推理能力，同时支持交叉手握合成并自然地扩展到复杂的多目标场景。representation and evaluated by a hand-agnostic decision model. This design retains efficient inference while supporting cross-hand grasp synthesis and extending naturally to complex multi-object scenes.

Ⅱ-CII-C 具身智能的基础模型Foundation Models in Embodied Intelligence

基础模型Foundation models[54]，具有强大的感知能力, with their powerful capabilities in perception[7, 55]和推理and reasoning[56, 57]，正在成为通用智能系统的重要基石。它们广泛用于高层规划, are becoming a vital cornerstone for general-purpose intelligent systems. They are widely used for high-level planning[10, 11]和低级控制and low-level control[12, 13]在机器人技术中。当前的应用可大致分为三种类型：（i）零样本利用，其中基础先验直接用于具体导航in robotics. Current applications can be broadly categorized into three types: (i) zero-shot utilization, where foundation priors are directly used for embodied navigation[58, 59]和操纵and manipulation[60, 61]无需额外培训； (ii) 针对特定任务的适应，其中基础模型通过有效的微调来适应机器人任务without additional training; (ii) task-specific adaptation, where foundation models are adapted to robotic tasks through efficient finetuning[62, 63]; (iii) 融入行动政策，将基础模型嵌入闭环感知-行动管道中，一些工作进一步探索建立政策基础模型; and (iii) integration into action policies, where foundation models are embedded into closed-loop perception-action pipelines, and some works further explore building policy foundation models[64, 13]在大规模机器人数据集上进行训练。trained on large-scale robotic datasets.

受到之前工作的启发，AdaRoboVLG 利用并构建了不同的基础模型来实现自适应机器人抓取。具体来说，DINOv3Inspired by prior work, AdaRoboVLG leverages and composes diverse foundation models to enable adaptive robotic grasping. Specifically, DINOv3[7]和 SAM3and SAM3[25]直接以零样本的方式用于语义理解、目标分割和时间跟踪。与此同时，are directly employed in a zero-shot manner for semantic understanding, target segmentation, and temporal tracking. Meanwhile, the勒姆llm增强了与掌握相关的分类知识，以促进掌握功能推断。然后将由此产生的空间、认知和时间约束统一到结构化抓取界面中，以指导物理抓取合成。通过组合不同的基础先验，AdaRoboVLG 可以灵活地适应新的任务环境和抓取要求。is augmented with grasp-relevant taxonomy knowledge to facilitate grasp functionality inference. The resulting spatial, cognitive, and temporal constraints are then unified into a structured grasp interface to guide physical grasp synthesis. By composing diverse foundation priors, AdaRoboVLG can flexibly adapt to novel task contexts and grasping requirements.

V-A2 场景级Scene-levelcgr Prediction

To predict scene-level cgr from the multi-view scene observations, we adopt the PyTorch implementation of Contact-GraspNet11 1 https://github.com/SeungBack/gc6d-contact-graspnet. We train this network on the GraspClutter6D [27] dataset, retaining the original hyperparameter settings. Given the scene point cloud 𝒫𝒮\mathcal{P}_{\mathcal{S}} and semantic representations ℛ𝒮\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{S}}, the network produces dense per-point cgr {𝒂ns}\{\bm{a}_{n_{s}}\}. During inference, we reconstruct the scene-level cgr set by filtering these dense predictions with the contact probability threshold δc\delta_{c}:

𝒜𝒮={𝒂ns∣pns>δc}={𝒂js}.\displaystyle\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{S}}=\left\{\bm{a}_{n_{s}}\mid p_{n_{s}}>\delta_{c}\right\}=\{\bm{a}_{j_{s}}\}. (27)

Together with the scene geometry and all available grasp types, these cgr construct the task-conditioned interface for clutter-aware grasping. This interface further serves as the input to the cognitive prior, where the most suitable grasp type and target region are selected according to the task instruction.

V-B Cognitive Prior for Functional Grasping

For functional grasping in cluttered scenes, the task context further includes a natural language instruction ℓ\ell:

𝒞c={𝒮,ℓ}.\displaystyle\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{c}}=\{\mathcal{S},\ell\}. (28)

Given the multi-view scene observations and language instruction, the cognitive prior module ℳc​(⋅)\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{c}}(\cdot) infers the target object, functional part, and appropriate grasp types, and then aligns these constraints with 3D scene representations:

ℳc:(𝒮,ℓ,ℛ𝒮,𝒜𝒮)↦(𝒪,𝒯ℋ,ℛ𝒪,𝒜𝒪),\displaystyle\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{c}}:\left(\mathcal{S},\ell,\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{S}},\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{S}}\right)\mapsto\left(\mathcal{O},\mathcal{T}_{\mathcal{H}},\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{O}},\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{O}}\right), (29)

where ℛ𝒪={𝒓no}no=1|ℛ𝒪|\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{O}}=\{\bm{r}_{n_{o}}\}_{n_{o}=1}^{|\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{O}}|} represents the set of object semantic representations extracted from the scene representations ℛ𝒮\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{S}}, while 𝒜𝒪={𝒂jo}jo=1|𝒜𝒪|\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{O}}=\{\bm{a}_{j_{o}}\}_{j_{o}=1}^{|\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{O}}|} denotes the functional cgr aligned with the grounded target object and the functional part.

V-B1 Grasp Functionality Inference

To understand human language instructions, we instantiate a parsing function Ψ⁡(⋅)\Psi(\cdot) with an llm to infer the structured grasp specification:

(ℓobj,ℓpart,𝒯ℋ)=Ψ⁡(𝒮,ℓ),\displaystyle\left(\ell_{\mathrm{obj}},\ell_{\mathrm{part}},\mathcal{T}_{\mathcal{H}}\right)=\Psi\left(\mathcal{S},\ell\right), (30)

where ℓobj\ell_{\mathrm{obj}} and ℓpart\ell_{\mathrm{part}} denote the language descriptors for the target object and its functional part. Direct inference of these physically grounded attributes is non-trivial due to the inherent lack of grasp reasoning in standard llm. To bridge this gap, we employ Seed-1.822 2 https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Seed-1.8 as the core reasoning agent, augmented with rag [23] and cot [24] mechanisms.

As shown in Fig. 7, we construct a grasp taxonomy database that encodes detailed attributes for predefined grasp types, including functional intent, active finger configurations, contact constraints, and use-case examples. By retrieving relevant knowledge from this database, we constrain the inference space and mitigate hallucinations in llm. Furthermore, we use cot prompting to decompose the inference into task intent identification, functional part selection, and grasp requirement analysis, ultimately outputting ℓobj\ell_{\mathrm{obj}}, ℓpart\ell_{\mathrm{part}}, and 𝒯ℋ\mathcal{T}_{\mathcal{H}}.

V-B2 Object Semantic Representation Refinement

Then, we ground the parsed object description ℓobj\ell_{\mathrm{obj}} in the scene semantic representations. To localize the target object, we perform visual grounding conditioned on the parsed object description, such as “the mug”. Specifically, we use Seed-1.8 to generate bounding-box annotations on multi-view RGB images. These annotations are then used as prompts for SAM3 [25] to extract multi-view instance masks, denoted as 𝒲inst={𝒘minst}m=1Nv\mathcal{W}^{\mathrm{inst}}=\{\bm{w}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{m}\}_{m=1}^{N_{v}}.

We further lift the 2D instance masks into 3D space using the implicit field function defined in Eq. 25, yielding a point-wise instance probability 𝒖nsinst∈[0,1]\bm{u}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{n_{s}}\in[0,1] for each scene point. To obtain object semantic representations, we filter the scene-level representations and retain only those associated with the grounded target instance:

ℛ𝒪≜{𝒓ns∈ℛ𝒮∣𝒖nsinst>δinst}={𝒓no}.\displaystyle\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{O}}\triangleq\left\{\bm{r}_{n_{s}}\in\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{S}}\mid\bm{u}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{n_{s}}>\delta_{\mathrm{inst}}\right\}=\{\bm{r}_{n_{o}}\}. (31)

The corresponding target object geometry 𝒪\mathcal{O} is extracted from the scene point cloud using the same grounded instance mask.

V-B3 Functional cgr Alignment

We further use the parsed part description ℓpart\ell_{\mathrm{part}}, such as “the handle”, to restrict grasp generation to the corresponding functional regions. Analogous to the instance grounding, we derive a point-wise functional probability 𝒖nsfun∈[0,1]\bm{u}^{\mathrm{fun}}_{n_{s}}\in[0,1] by identifying functional regions through visual grounding and 3D lifting. To extract task-relevant contact primitives, we filter the scene-level cgr set 𝒜𝒮\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{S}} by enforcing both instance-level and functional-level consistency:

𝒜𝒪≜{𝒂ns∈𝒜𝒮∣𝒖nsinst>δinst∧𝒖nsfun>δfun}={𝒂jo},\displaystyle\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{O}}\triangleq\left\{\bm{a}_{n_{s}}\in\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{S}}\mid\bm{u}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{n_{s}}>\delta_{\mathrm{inst}}\land\bm{u}^{\mathrm{fun}}_{n_{s}}>\delta_{\mathrm{fun}}\right\}=\left\{\bm{a}_{j_{o}}\right\}, (32)

该集合提供了功能相关且空间可行的This set provides functionally relevant and spatially feasible累积量cgr掌握综合的候选人。与物体几何形状一起candidates for grasp synthesis. Together with the object geometry𝒪\mathcal{O}以及推断的抓握类型and the inferred grasp types𝒯ℋ\mathcal{T}_{\mathcal{H}}，它形成了语言引导的功能性抓取的任务条件接口。, it forms the task-conditioned interface for language-guided functional grasping.

对于动态杂乱场景中的功能性抓取，任务上下文包括连续的观察序列和语言指令：For functional grasping in dynamic cluttered scenes, the task context comprises a continuous observation sequence and a language instruction:

𝒞t={𝒮0:t,ℓ}.\displaystyle\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{t}}=\{\mathcal{S}_{0:t},\ell\}. (33)

在初始时间步At the initial time stept=0t=0，空间和认知先验构建了初始掌握界面：, the spatial and cognitive priors construct the initial grasp interface:

ℐ0=(𝒪0,𝒜0𝒪,𝒯ℋ).\displaystyle\mathcal{I}_{0}=\left(\mathcal{O}_{0},\mathcal{A}^{\mathcal{O}}_{0},\mathcal{T}_{\mathcal{H}}\right). (34)

时间先验模块The temporal prior moduleℳt​(⋅)\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{t}}(\cdot)通过连续观察更新此界面以保持时间一致的抓取跟踪：updates this interface across continuous observations to maintain temporally consistent grasp tracking:

在刚体假设下，如果抓握在初始时间步长是稳定的，那么只要手严格跟踪物体的刚性运动，它在后续时间步长中也保持稳定。因此，我们实例化Under the rigid-body assumption, if a grasp is stable at the initial time step, it remains stable at subsequent time steps provided that the hand strictly tracks the object’s rigid motion. Therefore, we instantiateℳt​(⋅)\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{t}}(\cdot)来估计实时的to estimate the real-timeSE⁡(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)目标对象的变换。随后应用估计的变换来更新抓取界面，为基本抓取策略提供时间一致的输入。管道如图所示transformation of the target object. The estimated transformation is subsequently applied to update the grasp interface, providing temporally consistent inputs for the base grasp policy. The pipeline is depicted inFig. 8.

电压-CV-C1 对象跟踪一致性Object Tracking Consistency

为了保持对象跟踪的一致性，我们利用 SAM3 基于掩模的跟踪机制To maintain object tracking consistency, we leverage the mask-based tracking mechanism of SAM3[25]。我们不是在每个时间步执行独立的视觉基础，而是初始化目标实例掩码. Instead of performing independent visual grounding at each time step, we initialize the target instance mask𝒲0inst\mathcal{W}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{0}在初始时间步并随着时间的推移传播它。这种基于掩码的跟踪策略有效地减轻了顺序分割的不稳定性和语义漂移，确保跟踪的实例掩码at the initial time step and propagate it over time. This mask-based tracking strategy effectively mitigates sequential segmentation instability and semantic drift, ensuring that the tracked instance mask𝒲tinst\mathcal{W}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{t}在整个抓取过程中与目标物体保持严格一致。随后，remains strictly consistent with the target object throughout the grasping process. Subsequently,𝒪t\mathcal{O}_{t}从实时场景观察中提取并is extracted from the real-time scene observation and𝒲tinst\mathcal{W}^{\mathrm{inst}}_{t}.

VI 模拟实验Simulated Experiments

在本节中，我们在仿真中系统地验证了 AdaRoboVLG 的关键组件。我们首先介绍数据收集和训练设置（In this section, we systematically validate the key components of AdaRoboVLG in simulation. 我们在 Ubuntu 20.04 上的 PyTorch 中实现了抓取决策模型，并在具有双 Intel Xeon 6330 28 核 CPU、四个 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU 和 256 GB RAM 的服务器上对其进行训练。我们使用 Adam 优化器，学习率为We implement the grasp decision model in PyTorch on Ubuntu 20.04, and train it on a server with dual Intel Xeon 6330 28-core CPUs, four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs, and 256 GB of RAM. We use the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of1×10−41\times 10^{-4}和重量衰减and a weight decay of0.050.05。该模型使用二元交叉熵损失和余弦退火学习率调度程序进行了 30 个周期的训练，批量大小为 512。. The model is trained for 30 epochs with a batch size of 512, using the binary cross-entropy loss and a cosine annealing learning rate scheduler.

六-BVI-B 通用掌握综合基础政策评价Evaluation of the Base Policy for General Grasp Synthesis

基本策略由两个阶段组成：特定于手的抓取映射和与手无关的抓取评估。第一阶段被实例化为显式函数，并支持使用两到五个手指在末端执行器上进行部署，如后续实验所示。因此，我们重点评估拟议的The base policy consists of two stages: hand-specific grasp mapping and hand-agnostic grasp evaluation. The first stage is instantiated as an explicit function and supports deployment across end-effectors with two to five fingers, as demonstrated in subsequent experiments. 六-CVI-C 杂乱感知抓取的空间先验评估Evaluation of Spatial Prior for Clutter-Aware Grasping

该实验评估了空间先验将多视图观察转化为用于抓取合成的场景级接触约束的有效性，支持在不同级别的场景杂波下生成空间上可行的抓取。This experiment evaluates the effectiveness of the spatial prior in transforming multi-view observations into scene-level contact constraints for grasp synthesis, supporting spatially feasible grasp generation under different levels of scene clutter.

六-CVI-C1 基准设定Benchmark Setting

我们采用DexGraspNet 2.0中提出的模拟基准We adopt the simulated benchmark proposed in DexGraspNet 2.0[26]，它基于 GraspNet-1Billion 数据集构建, which is built upon the GraspNet-1Billion dataset[28]，包含 450 个场景和 88 个不同的对象。为了评估不同杂波水平下的模型性能，根据对象密度将测试场景分为三个难度划分：, and comprises 450 scenes and 88 diverse objects. To evaluate the model performance under different clutter levels, the test scenes are categorized into three difficulty splits based on object density:

  • •

    密集Dense由 GraspNet-1Billion 测试集中的 90 个场景组成consists of 90 scenes from the test set in GraspNet-1Billion[28]，每个场景包含 8-11 个对象。, with each scene containing 8-11 objects.

  • •

    随机Random通过两次增强密集分割来包含 180 个场景，其中每个场景保留 1-10 个随机对象。comprises 180 scenes by augmenting the dense split twice, where each scene retains 1-10 random objects.

  • •

    松动Loose通过两次增强密集分割来包含 180 个场景，场景中保留 1-2 个随机对象。contains 180 scenes by augmenting the dense split twice, with 1-2 random objects remaining in the scene.

所有实验均在 Isaac Gym 进行，摩擦系数设置为All experiments are conducted in Isaac Gym, where the friction coefficient is set toμ=0.2\mu=0.2.

六-CVI-C2 评估指标Evaluation Metrics

我们报告把握We report the grasp成功率success rate，遵循与 DexGraspNet 2.0 相同的评估协议, following the same evaluation protocol as DexGraspNet 2.0[26]。具体来说，如果得分最高的抓取姿势将物体从桌子上抬起而没有与桌子或周围物体发生任何初始碰撞，则抓取试验被认为是成功的。. Specifically, a grasp trial is considered a success if the highest-scoring grasp pose lifts the object off the table without any initial collision with the table or surrounding objects.

六-CVI-C3 基线模型Baseline Models

我们将 AdaRoboVLG 与 AnyDexGrasp 进行比较We compare AdaRoboVLG against AnyDexGrasp[71]及其变体 AnyDexGraspand its variant, AnyDexGrasp∗。 AnyDexGrasp 是一个两阶段的灵巧抓取框架，它首先预测与手无关的抓取表示以生成特定于手的抓取候选者，然后采用特定于手的决策模型来选择可执行抓取。因为它支持相同的三个机械手并采用与我们一致的抓取分类法，所以我们构建了 AnyDexGrasp. AnyDexGrasp is a two-stage dexterous grasping framework that first predicts a hand-agnostic grasp representation to generate hand-specific grasp candidates, and subsequently employs a hand-specific decision model to select executable grasps. Because it supports the same three robotic hands and adopts a grasp taxonomy consistent with ours, we construct AnyDexGrasp∗作为我们的掌握决策模型增强的变体。as a variant augmented with our grasp decision model.

AnyDexGrasp, AnyDexGrasp∗、AdaRoboVLG 在三到五个手指的三只机械手（DH3、Allegro 和 Inspire）上以零样本方式进行评估，无需任何重新训练。对于 AnyDexGrasp 和 AnyDexGrasp, and AdaRoboVLG are evaluated in a zero-shot manner on three robotic hands spanning three to five fingers (DH3, Allegro, and Inspire), without any re-training. For AnyDexGrasp and AnyDexGrasp∗，我们使用官方发布的表示模型来生成与手无关的抓取候选者。 AnyDexGrasp 使用其原始决策模型对这些候选者进行评分，而 AnyDexGrasp, we use the officially released representation model to generate hand-agnostic grasp candidates. AnyDexGrasp scores these candidates with its original decision model, whereas AnyDexGrasp∗使用我们的掌握决策模型进行候选人排名。在推理过程中，选择得分最高的抓取姿势来执行。uses our grasp decision model for candidate ranking. During inference, the highest-scoring grasp pose is selected for execution.

VI-D 功能性抓取的认知先验评估Evaluation of Cognitive Prior for Functional Grasping

该实验评估了认知先验将语言指令转换为用于掌握合成的功能掌握约束的有效性。由于当前的模拟基准在联合评估抓取功能推理、目标定位和物理抓取执行方面存在不足，因此我们通过两个互补的实验来评估此先前模块：开放集指令上的抓取功能推理和模拟杂乱中的语言引导目标抓取。This experiment evaluates the effectiveness of the cognitive prior in converting language instructions into functional grasp constraints for grasp synthesis. Because current simulation benchmarks fall short in jointly evaluating grasp functionality inference, target grounding, and physical grasp execution, we assess this prior module from two complementary experiments: grasp functionality inference on open-set instructions and language-guided target grasping in simulated clutter.

VI-D1 掌握功能推理Grasp Functionality Inference

为了评估掌握功能推理，我们基于指令模板构建了一个开放集指令数据集To evaluate grasp functionality inference, we construct an open-set instruction dataset based on instruction templates[29, 77]。该数据集包含 125 个图像指令对，涵盖 57 个操作任务和 80 个对象类别，并具有人类注释的地面实况功能抓取意图。我们报告功能部分和掌握类型准确性作为评估指标。. The dataset contains 125 image-instruction pairs spanning 57 manipulation tasks and 80 object categories, with human-annotated ground-truth functional grasp intents. We report functional part and grasp type accuracy as evaluation metrics.

我们进行消融研究来评估个体的贡献We conduct an ablation study to evaluate the individual contributions of the婴儿床cot和and抹布rag认知推理模块中的机制。mechanisms in the cognitive reasoning module.Tab. II表明整合demonstrates that integrating抹布rag和and婴儿床cot技术大大提高了模型的掌握功能推理准确性。这种高效的设计消除了对大规模语言-动作配对数据的依赖，从而大幅降低了整体学习成本。techniques substantially improves the model’s grasp functionality inference accuracy. This efficient design eliminates the reliance on large-scale language-action paired data, thereby substantially reducing the overall learning cost.

六-EVI-E 动态抓取的时间先验评估Evaluation of Temporal Prior for Dynamic Grasping

该实验评估了时间先验将连续视觉观察转换为时间一致的运动约束以进行抓取更新的能力，从而实现鲁棒的抓取跟踪。This experiment evaluates the capability of the temporal prior to convert continuous visual observations into temporally consistent motion constraints for grasp updates, thereby enabling robust grasp tracking.

我们将 AdaRoboVLG 与五个基线模型进行比较，包括 Nearest、AnyGraspWe compare AdaRoboVLG with five baseline models, comprising Nearest, AnyGrasp[78], 捆绑轨道, BundleTrack[79], 目标参考, Target-referenced[80]、和运动抓取, and MotionGrasp[81].

六-EVI-E4 实验细节Experimental Details

遵循之前工作中的协议Following the protocol in prior work[81]，我们使用 RealSense 捕获的数据进行训练和评估。为了训练基线，我们通过按顺序分组 7 个连续帧来提取每个场景的 250 个视频剪辑。为了进行评估，我们从每个测试场景中提取 17 个剪辑，并使用每个剪辑的前 7 帧进行抓取跟踪。在基线设置中，从初始帧中选择前 10 个得分最高的抓取候选对象以供模型跟踪。, we use the data captured by the RealSense for training and evaluation. To train the baselines, we extract 250 video clips per scene by sequentially grouping 7 consecutive frames. For evaluation, we extract 17 clips from each test scene and use the first 7 frames of each clip for grasp tracking. In the baseline setup, the top-10 highest-scoring grasp candidates are selected from the initial frame for the model to track.

相比之下，我们的跟踪模块完全无需训练。我们将抓取跟踪表述为刚性物体运动估计问题。因此，几何精度测量相当于评估物体位姿估计误差。与此同时，In contrast, our tracking module is entirely training-free. We formulate grasp tracking as a rigid object motion estimation problem. Consequently, geometric precision measurement is equivalent to evaluating the object pose estimation errors. Meanwhile, the毫克塔mgta指标是根据实例级跟踪精度计算的。对于每个测试片段，我们随机选择 2 到 3 个对象进行跟踪。给定他们在初始帧中的掩模，我们预测他们在整个视频剪辑中的连续姿势，并报告几何误差和关联度量。在实践中，为了解决优化目标metric is computed based on instance-level tracking accuracy. For each test clip, we randomly select 2 to 3 objects for tracking. Given their masks in the initial frame, we predict their continuous poses across the video clip and report both the geometric errors and association metrics. In practice, to solve the optimization objective inEq. 36，我们采用 Adam 优化器, we employ the Adam optimizer[84]100 次迭代。for 100 iterations.

七VII真实世界的实验Real-world Experiments

本节通过逐步组合不同的基础先验来解决日益具有挑战性的抓取场景，展示了 AdaRoboVLG 在现实世界中的适用性。介绍完实验设置后（This section demonstrates the real-world applicability of AdaRoboVLG by progressively composing different foundation priors to address increasingly challenging grasping scenarios. After introducing the experimental setup (Sec. VII-A），我们首先评估静态杂乱场景中功能性抓取的空间和认知先验的构成（), we first evaluate the composition of spatial and cognitive priors for functional grasping in static cluttered scenes (Sec. VII-B）。然后，我们通过结合时间先验来处理动态杂乱环境中的功能抓取，进一步增加任务复杂性（). We then further increase task complexity by incorporating the temporal prior to handle functional grasping in dynamic cluttered environments (Sec. VII-C）。最后， 我们展示了 AdaRoboVLG 对新任务和掌握要求的可扩展性（). Finally, we demonstrate the extensibility of AdaRoboVLG to new tasks and grasp requirements (Sec. VII-D).

VII-A 实验装置Experimental Setup

VII-A1 硬件平台Hardware Platforms

如图所示As shown inFig. 13，我们在三个机器人平台上进行了实际实验，包括 KEENON XMAN-R1 原型机、TianJi Marvin 和 AgileX Piper，这些平台配备了两种类型的末端执行器：平行爪夹具和 6 爪夹具。, we conduct real-world experiments on three robotic platforms, including the KEENON XMAN-R1 prototype, TianJi Marvin, and AgileX Piper, equipped with two types of end-effectors: a parallel-jaw gripper and a 6-自由度dofROHand灵巧的手。具体来说，在配备灵巧手的XMAN-R1和TianJi Marvin平台上，我们定量评估了杂乱场景中语言引导的功能抓取。为了进一步研究不同末端执行器的部署能力，我们为 TianJi Marvin 配备了平行爪夹具，并在相同的杂乱场景设置下进行了相同的评估。此外，在AgileX Piper平台上，我们评估了系统在动态杂乱场景中的功能抓取性能，并定量验证了人为干扰下抓取跟踪的时间鲁棒性。整个系统的实时推理是在配备NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU的工作站上执行的。ROHand dexterous hand. Specifically, on the XMAN-R1 and TianJi Marvin platforms equipped with the dexterous hand, we quantitatively evaluate language-guided functional grasping in cluttered scenes. To further investigate the deployment capability across different end-effectors, we equip the TianJi Marvin with a parallel-jaw gripper and conduct the same evaluation under the identical cluttered-scene setting. Furthermore, on the AgileX Piper platform, we evaluate the system’s functional grasping performance in dynamic cluttered scenes and quantitatively verify the temporal robustness of grasp tracking under human-induced disturbances. The real-time inference of the entire system is executed on a workstation equipped with an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU.

VII-A2 评估协议Evaluation Protocols

为了评估我们的方法在现实世界中的零样本性能，我们构建了一个由 102 个具有不同形状、材料和纹理的日常物体组成的测试集，涵盖六类：食物（22 个物体）、家居用品（22 个）、工具（18 个）、玩具（13 个）、电子产品（13 个）和纺织品（14 个）。只有正确识别目标物体、执行的抓取满足功能要求、执行过程中不与周围物体发生碰撞、物体被举起时，才认为试验成功。To evaluate the zero-shot performance of our method in the real world, we construct a test set of 102 everyday objects with diverse shapes, materials, and textures, covering six categories: food (22 objects), household items (22), tools (18), toys (13), electronics (13), and textiles (14). A trial is considered successful only when the target object is correctly identified, the executed grasp satisfies the functional requirement, no collision occurs with surrounding objects during execution, and the object is lifted by10 cm10\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}并举行了and held for5 s5\text{\,}\mathrm{s}不会被丢弃。根据该协议，我们在代表性的现实世界抓取任务中使用平行爪夹具和 ROHand 直接评估 AdaRoboVLG 的模拟到真实性能，无需现实世界的微调。 ROHand 的可行抓握类型遵循 Inspire-hand 抓握分类法中定义的without being dropped. Under this protocol, we directly evaluate the sim-to-real performance of AdaRoboVLG without real-world fine-tuning, using both a parallel-jaw gripper and the ROHand across representative real-world grasping tasks. The feasible grasp types for the ROHand follow the Inspire-hand grasp taxonomy defined in[71].

VII-B 静态杂乱场景中语言引导的功能抓取实验Experiments of Language-Guided Functional Grasping in Static Cluttered Scenes

VII-B1 任务描述Task Description

在此任务中，我们使用 ROHand 在 XMAN-R1 和 TianJi Marvin 平台上评估系统在密集杂乱中执行语言引导功能抓取的能力。对于 102 个目标对象中的每一个，我们构建一个杂乱的场景，其中包含一个与特定功能指令相关的目标对象、2-3 个具有相似语义类别或视觉外观的干扰项，以及其他背景对象。我们在随机物体姿势和场景配置下对每个物体进行了五次试验，总共产生了 510 次抓取试验。我们报告了两个平台汇总的类别级别和总体成功率。In this task, we evaluate the system’s ability to perform language-guided functional grasping in dense clutter using the ROHand on both the XMAN-R1 and TianJi Marvin platforms. For each of the 102 target objects, we construct a cluttered scene containing one target object associated with a specific functional instruction, 2–3 distractors with similar semantic categories or visual appearances, and additional background objects. We conduct five trials for each object under randomized object poses and scene configurations, yielding 510 grasping trials in total. We report the category-level and overall success rates aggregated from the two platforms.

VII-B2 实验结果Experimental Results

如图所示As shown inFig. 14，通过组合空间和认知先验，AdaRoboVLG 可以在杂乱的场景中生成空间上可行且功能上适当的灵巧抓握姿势。当目标对象被杂乱或遮挡的对象包围时（, by composing the spatial and cognitive priors, AdaRoboVLG can generate spatially feasible and functionally appropriate dexterous grasp poses in cluttered scenes. When the target object is surrounded by cluttered or occluding objects (例如e.g.，一个西瓜和一个牙签盒），我们的方法仍然可以可靠地规划无碰撞的抓握。对于具有明确功能可供性的工具或日常物品（, a watermelon and a toothpick box), our method can still reliably plan collision-free grasps. For tools or daily items with explicit functional affordances (例如e.g.、瓶子、扩音器和电钻），它选择与任务相关的功能部件和抓握类型，产生与人类物体使用行为一致的抓握。如图所示, a bottle, a megaphone, and a power drill), it selects task-relevant functional parts and grasp types, producing grasps consistent with human object-use behaviors. As illustrated inFig. 15(a)，AdaRoboVLG 在 510 次现实世界抓取试验中取得了 83.3% 的总体成功率。这些结果表明，该系统可以在现实杂乱的环境中可靠地执行目标识别、功能性抓取意图推断和灵巧抓取生成。, AdaRoboVLG achieves an overall success rate of 83.3% across 510 real-world grasping trials. These results demonstrate that the system can reliably perform target identification, functional grasp intent inference, and dexterous grasp generation in real-world clutter.

我们进一步总结了失效模式的分布We further summarize the distribution of failure modes inFig. 15(b)。功能部分识别错误是失败的主要原因，占不成功试验的 29.4%。这些失败主要发生在目标对象的功能区域不明确或视觉上与干扰物相似时，导致功能部分定位不正确。抓取姿态估计误差占22.3%，主要是由于姿态估计不准确或几何不确定性下候选选择不稳定造成的。接触稳定性不足占故障的 20.0%，通常发生在小型或表面光滑的物体上，其中生成的抓握在提升后无法保持可靠的接触。多物体干扰造成了 16.5% 的故障，即灵巧的手无意中抓住了密集杂乱中的多个物体。其余 11.8% 归因于抓取类型错误，当所选抓取类型与对象的功能要求不完全匹配时，就会发生这种错误。. Functional-part recognition errors constitute the primary source of failure, accounting for 29.4% of unsuccessful trials. These failures mainly occur when the target object’s functional regions are ambiguous or visually similar to distractors, leading to incorrect functional part localization. Grasp pose estimation errors account for 22.3%, primarily caused by inaccurate pose estimation or unstable candidate selection under geometric uncertainties. Insufficient contact stability represents 20.0% of failures, frequently occurring with small or smooth-surfaced objects where the generated grasps fail to maintain reliable contact after lifting. Multi-object interference contributes 16.5% of failures, where the dexterous hand unintentionally grasps multiple objects in dense clutter. The remaining 11.8% are attributed to grasp-type errors, which occur when the selected grasp type does not fully match the object’s functional requirements.

VII-C 动态杂乱场景中语言引导的功能抓取实验Experiments of Language-Guided Functional Grasping in Dynamic Cluttered Scenes

VII-C1 任务描述Task Description

该实验评估系统在动态杂乱场景中执行语言引导的功能性抓取的能力。它提供了对空间、认知和时间先验的可组合性的现实世界验证，以处理复杂的抓取场景。该实验是使用配备灵巧手的 AgileX Piper 进行的。我们选择 16 个有代表性的物体，并将它们与干扰物一起放置在以This experiment evaluates the ability of the system to perform language-guided functional grasping in dynamic cluttered scenes. It provides a real-world validation of the composability of spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors for handling complex grasping scenarios. The experiment is conducted using the AgileX Piper equipped with a dexterous hand. We select 16 representative objects and place them together with distractors on a moving conveyor belt operating at a speed of2 cm/s to 5 cm/s2\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{s}5\text{\,}\mathrm{cm}\text{/}\mathrm{s}。此外，为了定量评估跟踪鲁棒性，我们为同一机械臂配备了平行爪夹具。我们介绍了四种类型的人为干扰，包括视野外恢复、快速移动、连续遮挡以及同时平移和旋转。对于每种干扰条件，我们选择 10 个物体并进行五次重复抓取试验，报告所有条件下的平均成功率。. Furthermore, to quantitatively evaluate tracking robustness, we equip the same manipulator with a parallel-jaw gripper. We introduce four types of human-induced disturbances, including out-of-view recovery, fast movement, continuous occlusion, and simultaneous translation and rotation. For each disturbance condition, we select 10 objects and perform five repeated grasping trials, reporting the average success rate across all conditions.

VII-C2 实验结果Experimental Results

如图所示As illustrated inFig. 17，我们提出的框架展示了在动态杂乱的传送带场景中可靠的语言引导功能抓取，同时以 5 Hz 的频率在线更新抓取姿势。例如，在, our proposed framework demonstrates reliable language-guided functional grasping in dynamic cluttered conveyor-belt scenarios while updating grasp poses online at 5 Hz. For example, inFig. 17c，给定指令，空间先验约束抓取生成，以避免与相邻干扰物发生碰撞，而认知先验选择杯子手柄作为适当的功能部分，并将 Prismatic 3 Finger 确定为适合任务的抓取类型。然后，基本抓取策略为灵巧的手生成稳定且可执行的抓取姿势。时间先验进一步使系统能够在目标沿着传送带移动时稳健地跟踪目标。这些结果证明了为现实世界动态抓取构建空间、认知和时间先验的有效性。, given the instruction, the spatial prior constrains grasp generation to avoid collisions with adjacent distractors, while the cognitive prior selects the cup handle as the appropriate functional part and determines Prismatic 3 Finger as the task-suitable grasp type. The base grasp policy then produces stable and executable grasp poses for the dexterous hand. The temporal prior further enables the system to robustly track the target as it moves along the conveyor belt. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of composing the spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors for real-world dynamic grasping.

此外，据报道Furthermore, as reported inTab. V，系统在各种人为干扰下平均抓取成功率达到89.7%（见, the system achieves an average grasping success rate of 89.7% under various human-induced disturbances (seeFig. 18）。在快速运动、连续遮挡、同时平移和旋转等扰动下，时间跟踪模块保持目标特征一致性并持续更新抓取姿势。值得注意的是，即使在视野外恢复测试中，该系统也能快速恢复物体姿态估计和抓取规划，进一步验证了其在非静态现实环境中的鲁棒性。). Under perturbations such as fast motion, continuous occlusion, simultaneous translation and rotation, the temporal tracking module maintains target feature consistency and continuously updates grasp poses. Notably, even in out-of-view recovery tests, the system rapidly restores object pose estimation and grasp planning, further verifying its robustness in non-static real-world environments.

VII-D 自适应框架的可扩展性Extensibility of the Adaptive Framework

我们进一步证明，通过集成其他与任务相关的模块，我们的框架可以扩展到新的具有挑战性的抓取场景。如图所示We further demonstrate that our framework can be extended to new challenging grasping scenarios by integrating additional task-relevant modules. As illustrated inFig. 19，结合任务分配模块使 AdaRoboVLG 能够通过在两个手臂之间分配抓取目标来执行双手分拣。类似地，通过集成深度完成模块来支持透明物体抓取（, incorporating a task-allocation module enables AdaRoboVLG to perform bimanual sorting by distributing grasp targets between the two arms. Similarly, transparent-object grasping is supported by integrating a depth-completion module (例如e.g., SwinDRNet [85]）在构造结构化抓取界面之前恢复丢失的对象几何形状。这种可扩展性源于任务理解和物理掌握合成的解耦，这允许通过特定于任务的模块合并新功能，而不需要全新的策略。) to recover missing object geometry before constructing the structured grasp interface. This extensibility stems from the decoupling of task understanding and physical grasp synthesis, which allows new capabilities to be incorporated through task-specific modules without requiring an entirely new policy.

八VIII讨论与结论Discussion and Conclusion

VIII-A 局限性和未来方向Limitations and Future Directions

不确定性下的感知：Perception under Uncertainty:用于构建、完善和更新结构化掌握界面的基础模型先验仍然对感知不确定性敏感。具体来说，深度噪声可能会扭曲接触几何形状并影响抓取生成和评估，而不一致的交叉视图接地可能会导致错误的功能区域识别。此外，视觉观察的频繁变化很容易引起姿势漂移并引入不必要的更新延迟。为了解决这些限制，未来的工作可以集成更强大的基础模型。有希望的方向包括度量重建The foundation-model priors for constructing, refining, and updating the structured grasp interface remain sensitive to perceptual uncertainty. Specifically, depth noise can distort contact geometry and compromise grasp generation and evaluation, while inconsistent cross-view grounding can lead to incorrect functional-region identification. Furthermore, frequent changes in visual observations can easily induce pose drift and introduce unnecessary update latency. To address these limitations, future work could integrate more capable foundation models. Promising directions include metric reconstruction[86, 87]提高几何精度、跨视图对应to improve geometric accuracy, cross-view correspondence[88, 89]促进接地一致性和点跟踪方法to promote grounding consistency, and point-tracking methods[90]支持高效、低延迟的姿态估计。to support efficient, low-latency pose estimation.

闭环物理交互：Closed-loop Physical Interaction:我们的基本抓取策略通过视觉几何预测抓取稳定性，但缺乏触觉反馈来验证执行过程中的接触条件。因此，预测接触与实际接触之间的差异（包括接触力不足或初期滑动）可能不会被检测到，从而限制了小型或光滑物体的抓取鲁棒性。结合触觉反馈Our base grasp policy predicts grasp stability from visual geometry but lacks tactile feedback to verify contact conditions during execution. Discrepancies between predicted and actual contacts, including insufficient contact forces or incipient slip, may therefore remain undetected, limiting grasp robustness for small or smooth objects. Incorporating tactile feedback[91]可以通过直接接触测量来补充几何预测，支持闭环稳定性评估和手动校正调整。could complement geometric predictions with direct contact measurements, supporting closed-loop stability assessment and corrective in-hand adjustments.

超越单步抓取：Beyond Single-step Grasping:我们的框架综合了任务一致的抓取，但没有明确考虑抓取和其他操作动作之间的依赖关系。在非常混乱的场景中，可能需要准备动作来暴露目标，而随后的操作可能会对抓取选择施加额外的限制。整合非综合技能Our framework synthesizes task-consistent grasps but does not explicitly account for dependencies between grasping and other manipulation actions. In heavily cluttered scenes, preparatory actions may be needed to expose the target, while subsequent manipulation may impose additional constraints on grasp selection. Integrating non-prehensile skills[92]顺序任务规划可以支持抓取之前的场景重新排列，并协调抓取选择与后续动作。with sequential task planning could support scene rearrangement before grasping and coordinate grasp selection with subsequent actions.

VIII-B 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们介绍了 AdaRoboVLG，一种任务自适应的In this paper, we introduce AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive视频vlg支持跨不同机器人手部署的框架。它学习一种高效且可泛化的交叉掌握合成基本策略，同时将依赖于任务的理解转移到专门的基础模型模块。这些模块利用可组合先验将任务上下文转换为结构化抓取界面，从而允许基本策略生成任务一致且物理上可行的抓取姿势。广泛的模拟和现实世界实验表明，AdaRoboVLG 成功地合成了两到五指末端执行器的抓取，同时有效地结合了空间、认知和时间先验，以适应组合上下文条件下的不同抓取任务。framework that supports deployment across different robotic hands. It learns an efficient and generalizable base policy for cross-hand grasp synthesis while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules leverage composable priors to convert task contexts into a structured grasp interface, allowing the base policy to generate task-consistent and physically feasible grasp poses. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that AdaRoboVLG successfully synthesizes grasps across two- to five-finger end-effectors, while effectively incorporating spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to adapt to diverse grasping tasks under combined contextual conditions (例如e.g.、杂乱的场景、功能需求和动态交互）。通过在高级任务理解和低级抓取执行之间建立稳定的接口，AdaRoboVLG 为具有挑战性的抓取场景提供了一条可扩展的路径。, cluttered scenes, functional requirements, and dynamic interactions). By establishing a stable interface between high-level task understanding and low-level grasp execution, AdaRoboVLG provides a scalable path for challenging grasping scenarios.
